paragraphs: National CineMedia is the largest cinema advertising platform in the U.S. With unparalleled reach and scale, NCM connects brands to sought-after young, diverse audiences through the power of movies and pop culture. A premium video, full-funnel marketing solution for advertisers, NCM enhances advertisers' ability to measure and drive results. NCM's Noovie® Show is presented exclusively in 41 leading national and regional theater circuits including all three national chains, AMC, Cinemark and Regal. NCM's cinema advertising platform consists of more than 17,000 screens in over 1,300 theaters in 184 Designated Market Areas® ("DMA®"), including all of the top 50. In November of 2025, NCM extended its reach by acquiring Spotlight and the Spotlight Cinema Network, a U.S. cinema advertising company dedicated to serving art house, luxury and dine-in exhibitors. Spotlight and the Spotlight Cinema Network presents the CineLife® Show exclusively in 108 leading national and regional theater circuits consisting of more than 1,200 screens in over 200 theaters.

We derive revenue primarily from selling advertising to national, regional and local businesses through The Noovie Show and the CineLife Show, our cinema advertising and entertainment shows seen on movie screens across the U.S. Additionally, we generate revenue from the Lobby Entertainment Network or LEN, a series of strategically-placed screens located in movie theater lobbies, as well as other promotional opportunities in theater lobbies. Beyond the theater, we extend our advertising reach through our NCMx suite of products, leveraging omnichannel retargeting across our owned digital properties, partnerships with third-party digital publishers and platforms, CTV and a variety of complementary out-of-home venues, such as convenience stores and college campuses, to engage entertainment audiences beyond the theater.

The Company has long-term ESAs with the ESA Parties and multi-year agreements with our network affiliates, which grant the Company exclusive rights in their respective theaters to sell advertising, subject to limited exceptions. The weighted average remaining term of the ESAs with the ESA Parties is approximately 15.6 years as of January 1, 2026. The network affiliate agreements within NCM's legacy network expire at various dates between March 31, 2026 and July 13, 2033, with our largest affiliate agreement expiring on July 13, 2033. The weighted average remaining term of the ESAs and the network affiliate agreements of the NCM network is 11.8 years as of January 1, 2026.

NCM, Inc., a Delaware corporation, was organized on October 5, 2006 and began operations on February 13, 2007 upon completion of its IPO. NCM, Inc. is a holding company that manages its consolidated subsidiary, NCM LLC. NCM, Inc. has no business operations or material assets other than its cash and cash equivalents and ownership interest of 100.0% of the common membership units in NCM LLC as of January 1, 2026. In accordance with the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement, Cinemark has the right to potentially receive common membership units in NCM LLC in the future. Following the AMC Termination Agreement, AMC will no longer have the right to receive NCM LLC membership units as part of the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement. As of January 1, 2026, AMC and Cinemark have no ownership interest in NCM LLC.

NCM, Inc.'s primary source of cash flow from operations is distributions from NCM LLC pursuant to the NCM LLC Operating Agreement. NCM, Inc. also receives management fees pursuant to a management services agreement with NCM LLC.

Spotlight—On November 14, 2025, the Company acquired Spotlight, the only U.S. cinema advertising company dedicated to serving art house, luxury and dine-in exhibitors. The acquisition of Spotlight adds high-scale luxury screens and exhibitors that offer unique and engaging customer experiences to our platform, unlocking new advertising and preshow entertainment inventory across theaters nationwide. Spotlight's exhibitor partners, including Cinépolis Luxury Cinema, Landmark Theatres, Flix Brewhouse and LOOK Dine-In Cinemas, complement NCM's national theater network and extend NCM's reach among culturally engaged premium audiences. The addition of Spotlight's footprint increases NCM's national market share by more than 6.0% and expands its theater presence by approximately 30.0% in the critical New York and Los Angeles markets. The Company paid $8.2 million of purchase consideration to acquire 100.0% of the ownership of Spotlight. Spotlight was consolidated within the Company's financial statements for the period of November 15, 2025 through January 1, 2026. Refer to Footnote 5—Business Combinations for more information regarding the acquisition and consolidation of Spotlight.

AMC Advertising Agreement—On April 17, 2025, the Company and AMC, entered into the Second Amended and Restated Exhibitor Services Agreement (the "2025 AMC Agreement") and a separate termination agreement (the "AMC Termination Agreement") by and among NCM LLC, NCM, Inc. and AMC. The 2025 AMC Agreement extends the term of the ESA by five years, more closely aligns the program distributed by NCM LLC in AMC theaters to the predominant pre-feature program show structure in the rest of NCM LLC's advertising network and adjusts the consideration paid by NCM

LLC. The AMC Termination Agreement waives AMC's rights under certain agreements entered into at the time of the IPO. The agreements were accounted for in accordance with the lease modification guidance within ASC 842—Leases as the amended ESA contains a short-term operating lease of AMC's screens. The agreements were considered combined as they were entered into contemporaneously by the same parties. As a result of the agreements, in the quarter ended June 26, 2025, NCM LLC released $21.6 million of the 'Payable under the TRA' and reversed the receivable of $10.6 million from AMC, related to unpaid integration payments, and the receivable under the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement within 'Prepaid expenses and other assets' on the Company's unaudited Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet. NCM will no longer have an obligation to make TRA payments to AMC, provide common units as a part of the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement or distribute NCM LLC's available cash to AMC and the Company received the benefits of the revised ESA, including enhancements related to the pre-feature show structure and the exclusive right to advertise in AMC's theaters. The net impact of these reversals was recorded to the 'Intangible Assets, net of amortization' as AMC's forfeiture of this net payable was considered akin to a lease incentive. The reduction in the intangible asset for the ESAs and the extension of the term of the ESA will result in reduced amortization expense, as it is considered akin to lease expense, for the remainder of the contract term. Refer to Note 6—Intangible Assets, Note 7 —Income Taxes, and Note 13—Commitments and Contingencies and the Company's Form 8-K filed with the SEC on April 23, 2025 for additional detail surrounding these agreements.

Debt Agreement—On January 24, 2025, NCM LLC entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with U.S. Bank National Association, as lender. The agreement provides for a $45.0 million senior secured revolving credit facility (the "2025 Credit Facility") that matures on January 24, 2028. In connection with entering into the 2025 Credit Facility, NCM LLC repaid in full the $10.0 million balance outstanding as of December 26, 2024, terminated all commitments under its prior Loan, Security and Guarantee Agreement (the "Revolving Credit Facility 2023"), dated August 7, 2023, with CIT Northbridge Credit LLC, as agent, and paid a prepayment fee equal to 1.0% of the total commitment. The 2025 Credit Facility has reduced the Company's overall interest expense, extended the maturity date to 2028 and is a cash flow-based revolving loan compared to the asset-based revolving loan of the 2023 Revolving Credit Facility. As of January 1, 2026, NCM LLC has $12.0 million outstanding under the 2025 Credit Facility. Borrowings under the 2025 Credit Facility may be used for, among other things, working capital and other general corporate purposes of the Company and bear interest at a floating rate equal to term SOFR (subject to a floor of zero) plus an applicable margin of 2.00%, which is subject to increase by an additional 2.00% upon the occurrence of an event of default.

Reverse Stock Split—On August 3, 2023, the Company effected a one-for-ten (1:10) reverse stock split of its common stock, par value $0.01 per share. The reverse stock split reduced the number of outstanding shares of the Company's common stock from 174,112,385 shares as of August 3, 2023, to 17,411,323 shares outstanding post-split. After the cancellation of Regal's shares on August 7, 2023, there were 13,343,065 shares outstanding. The primary purpose of the reverse stock split was to comply with the Company's obligations under the NCMI 9019 Settlement discussed under "Chapter 11 Proceedings" below, as well as to increase the per share market price of the Company's common stock in an effort to maintain compliance with applicable Nasdaq continued listing standards.

Share Repurchase Program—On March 18, 2024, the Board of Directors of the Company approved a stock repurchase program under which the Company is authorized to use assets of the Company to repurchase up to $100.0 million of shares of the Company's Common Stock, exclusive of any fees, commissions or other expenses related to such repurchases, from time to time over a period of three years. Shares may be repurchased under the program through open market purchases, block trades, or accelerated or other structured share repurchase programs. During the year ended January 1, 2026 and December 26, 2024, 4.1 million and 2.5 million shares were repurchased on the open market, respectively. In accordance with ASC 505 —Equity, the Company elected to retire the shares. Upon the retirement of these shares, the excess over par value paid, inclusive of direct costs, of $22.3 million and $13.4 million was recorded as a reduction to retained earnings for the year ended January 1, 2026 and December 26, 2024, respectively. As of January 1, 2026, 6.6 million shares have been repurchased on the open market since the program's inception.

Regal Advertising Agreement—On September 7, 2022, Cineworld Group plc, the parent company of Regal, and certain of its subsidiaries, including Regal, Regal Cinemas, Inc., formerly a party to an ESA with NCM LLC, and Regal CineMedia Holdings, LLC, formerly a party to other agreements with NCM LLC and the Company, filed petitions for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code in the Southern District of Texas. In connection with their Chapter 11 process, Regal filed a motion to reject the ESA and NCM LLC filed an adversary proceeding against Regal. On June 3, 2023, following extensive negotiations, NCM LLC, entered into a Network Affiliate Transaction Agreement (the "Regal Advertising Agreement") with Regal. The Regal Advertising Agreement became effective on July 14, 2023. Pursuant to a separate termination agreement (the "Regal Termination Agreement"), effective on July 14, 2023, Regal rejected and terminated its ESA. Additionally Regal and Regal's affiliates' waived all rights and interests as to the TRA, the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement, the Software License Agreement, the Director Designation Agreement, the Registration Rights Agreement and all the other joint venture agreements described in the NCM LLC Operating Agreement and the Company and NCM LLC, and Regal and Regal's affiliates waived and released claims against the other party. Regal also agreed to support NCM LLC's Plan (as defined under "Chapter 11 Proceedings" below) and surrendered all shares of NCM, Inc.

common stock upon the Effective Date. In connection with the Regal Advertising Agreement, NCM LLC and Regal also agreed to dismiss with prejudice the ongoing litigation between the parties related to NCM LLC's request to enforce certain provisions of the ESA, including the exclusivity provision. As of July 14, 2023, Regal is no longer an ESA Party of NCM, Inc. or NCM LLC and is presented within network affiliate balances and metrics subsequent to July 14, 2023.

On April 11, 2023, NCM LLC filed a voluntary petition for reorganization ("Chapter 11 Case") with a prearranged Chapter 11 plan under Chapter 11 of Title 11 of the United States Code (the "Bankruptcy Code") in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas (the "Bankruptcy Court").

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Significant declines in theater attendance could reduce the attractiveness of cinema advertising and could reduce our revenue.
Changes in theater patron behavior could result in declines in the viewership of The Noovie® Show which could reduce the attractiveness of cinema advertising and our revenues.
Changes in the ESAs with, or lack of support by, the ESA Parties could adversely affect our revenue, growth and profitability.
If the non-competition provisions of the ESAs or other advertising agreements are deemed unenforceable, the counterparties could compete against us and our business could be adversely affected.
The ESA with an ESA Party that has declared bankruptcy may be rejected, renegotiated or deemed unenforceable.
Pandemics, epidemics or disease outbreaks, such as the COVID-19 virus, have disrupted and could materially affect our business and the business of NCM LLC's network theaters in the future.

We may not realize the anticipated benefits of additional Post-Showtime inventory or be successful in increasing the number of theaters in which NCM LLC has the right to display Post-Showtime inventory.
Our business relies heavily on technology systems, and any failures, disruptions or cyberattacks may materially and adversely affect our operations.
Our plans for developing additional digital or digital out-of-home revenue opportunities may not be implemented and may not be achieved.
The 2025 Credit Facility contains restrictions and may not provide sufficient capital resources and flexibility for the Company in the future.

The personal information we collect and maintain through our data and digital services, as well as from third-party sources, may expose us to liability or cause us to incur greater operating expenses.
The markets for advertising are competitive and we may be unable to compete successfully.
If we do not continue to upgrade our technology, our business could fail to grow and revenue and operating margins could decline.
Economic uncertainty or deterioration in economic conditions may adversely impact our business, operating results or financial condition.
We are subject to risks from changes to regulations, government funding, trade policies and tariffs imposed by governments that impact our advertising clients.

Our contracts for theater advertising allow certain counterparties to engage in activities that might compete with certain elements of our business, which could reduce our revenue and growth potential.
We depend upon our senior management and our business may be adversely affected if we cannot retain or replace them.
Our use of AI in our offerings may not result in the expected benefits.
We may be unable to realize the expected benefits and synergies of any acquisitions or investments.
We may be unable to effectively manage changes to our business strategy to continue the growth of our advertising inventory and network.
Our revenue and Adjusted OIBDA fluctuate from quarter to quarter and may be unpredictable, which could increase the volatility of our stock price.
Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure

We are a holding company with no operations of our own, and we depend on distributions and payments under the NCM LLC operating and management services agreements from NCM LLC to meet our ongoing obligations.
paragraphs: Ownership of the common stock and other securities of the Company involves certain risks. You should carefully consider the following material risks and other information in this document, including our historical financial statements and related notes included herein. The material risks and uncertainties described in this document are not the only ones facing us. If any of the risks and uncertainties described in this document actually occur, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected in a material way. This could cause the trading price of our common stock to decline, perhaps significantly, and you may lose part or all of your investment.

Our business is affected by the level of attendance at the theaters in our advertising network that operate in a highly competitive industry and whose attendance is reliant on the presence of motion pictures that attract audiences. The value of our advertising business could be adversely affected by a decline in theater attendance or even the perception by media buyers that our network is no longer relevant to their marketing plan due to the decreases in attendance and geographic coverage. Factors that could reduce attendance at our network theaters include the following:

• if NCM LLC's network theater circuits cannot compete with other entertainment due to an increase in the use of alternative film delivery methods (and the shortening or elimination of the "release window" of major motion pictures bypassing the theater entirely), including network and online video streaming and downloads;

• theater circuits in NCM LLC's network are expected to continue to renovate auditoriums in certain of their theaters to install new larger, more comfortable seating or adjust seating arrangements, reducing the number of seats and the audience size in a theater auditorium. These renovations have been viewed favorably by patrons and many theater circuits have noted an intent to continue such renovations;

• changes in theater operating policies, including the number and length of trailers for films that are played prior to the start of the feature film, which may result in most or all of The Noovie® Show starting further out from the actual start of the feature film;
• any reduction in consumer confidence or disposable income in general that reduces the demand for motion pictures or adversely affects the motion picture production or exhibition industries;

Bankruptcy Filing, Deconsolidation and Reconsolidation of NCM LLC—On April 11, 2023, NCM LLC filed a voluntary petition for reorganization with a prearranged Chapter 11 plan under Chapter 11 of Title 11 of the United States Code in the Bankruptcy Code in the Bankruptcy Court. During the Chapter 11 Case, the Company was deemed to no longer control NCM LLC for accounting purposes and NCM LLC was deconsolidated from the Company's financial statements prospectively as of April 11, 2023. We continued to operate as the manager of the debtor-in-possession pursuant to the authority granted under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code throughout the Chapter 11 Case.

On June 27, 2023, the Bankruptcy Court entered the Confirmation Order approving the Disclosure Statement on a final basis and confirming the Company's Plan. Following confirmation of the Plan on August 7, 2023, all the conditions to effectiveness of the Plan were satisfied or waived, the Restructuring Transactions were substantially consummated and NCM LLC emerged from bankruptcy. Among other things, on the Effective Date, in accordance with the Plan, all common units under the NCM LLC Operating Agreement were canceled and extinguished, NCM, Inc. received NCM LLC common units and transferred the NCM Capital Contribution of approximately $15.5 million to NCM LLC, NCM LLC assumed certain unexpired Executory Contracts and Unexpired Leases, including AMC's and Cinemark's ESAs, NCM LLC transferred $8.8 million of cash to a professional fees escrow account and $15.0 million to an unsecured creditor settlements escrow account for the General Unsecured Claim Pool. NCM LLC commenced distributions to creditors, including the issuance of shares of NCM, Inc. common stock to holders of Secured Debt Claims and NCM LLC entered into an Exit Facility to support operations upon emergence. As a result of the Plan, all historical debt of NCM LLC was discharged and NCM LLC recorded a gain on bankruptcy of $916.4 million for the year ended December 28, 2023.

Additionally, upon emergence from bankruptcy, NCM, Inc., regained control and retained 100.0% ownership of NCM LLC, after taking into account elections by the holders of Secured Debt Claims to receive NCM, Inc. common stock in lieu of NCM LLC common units and was therefore reconsolidated into the Company's financial statements prospectively as of August 7, 2023 akin to an acquisition under ASC 805 – Business Combinations. In accordance with ASC 805 – Business Combinations, the assets and liabilities of NCM LLC were adjusted to their estimated fair value as of the Effective Date.

As of January 1, 2026, the Company has not completed all agreed upon payments to the General Unsecured Claim Pool, due to the existence of one pre-petition litigation matter that is ongoing in the Bankruptcy Court, which could impact the payments to other unsecured creditors from the General Unsecured Claims Pool. As a result, the Company held a total of $3.0 million within the escrow accounts and accruals, presented within ‘Restricted cash' and ‘Accounts Payable' on the audited Consolidated Balance Sheets as of January 1, 2026 and December 26, 2024, respectively.

Regal Advertising Agreement—On September 7, 2022, Cineworld Group plc, the parent company of Regal, and certain of its subsidiaries, including Regal, Regal Cinemas, Inc., formerly a party to an ESA with NCM LLC, and Regal CineMedia Holdings, LLC, formerly a party to other agreements with NCM LLC and NCM, Inc., filed petitions for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code in the Southern District of Texas. On October 21, 2022, Regal filed a motion to reject the ESA without specifying an effective date for the rejection and indicated that Regal planned on negotiating with NCM LLC. NCM LLC also filed an adversary proceeding against Regal seeking declaratory relief and an injunction prohibiting Regal from breaching certain exclusivity, non-compete, non-negotiate and confidentiality provisions in the ESA by entering into a new agreement with a third-party or bringing any of the services performed by NCM LLC in-house. On February 1, 2023, Cineworld filed a motion for summary judgment on NCM LLC's adversary proceeding. On May 5, 2023, NCM LLC and Regal agreed to stay the ongoing litigation while the parties worked towards the terms of a new arrangement for NCM LLC to provide advertising services to Regal. In lieu of litigating Regal's potential rejection of the ESA and NCM LLC's adversary proceeding against Regal, the parties negotiated a Regal Advertising Agreement and Regal Termination Agreement. The Regal Advertising Agreement was effective on July 14, 2023 and provides that NCM LLC acquired the exclusive right to provide on-screen advertisements at Regal's theaters for a term of ten years in exchange for payments based on the attendance at Regal's theaters and the revenue generated by NCM LLC through advertising displayed in Regal's theaters.

Pursuant to the Regal Advertising Agreement, NCM LLC has the right to display advertising in Regal's theaters with a program of inventory that provides for (i) up to five minutes in length for exhibition on-screen immediately prior to showtime of a feature film or digital programming event, (ii) up to ten minutes immediately after the showtime of a feature film, extending the time available to NCM LLC by five minutes, and (iii) the Platinum Spot that may be exhibited on-screen prior to the last two trailers, which may be either thirty or sixty seconds in length, and subject to Regal's approval, NCM LLC may display two thirty-second spots in the Platinum Spot and a Gold Spot, a thirty second spot displayed immediately prior to the fourth trailer preceding a feature film or digital programming event.

Pursuant to the Regal Termination Agreement, effective on July 14, 2023, Regal rejected and terminated the ESA. Additionally Regal and Regal's affiliates' waived all rights and interests as to the Tax Receivable Agreement, the Common Unit Adjustment Agreement, the Software License Agreement, the Director Designation Agreement, the Registration Rights Agreement and all the other joint venture agreements described in NCM LLC's Company Operating Agreement and Regal and Regal's affiliates waived and released claims against other parties thereto. In connection with the Regal Advertising Agreement, NCM LLC and Regal also agreed to dismiss with prejudice the ongoing litigation between the parties related to NCM LLC's request to enforce certain provisions of the ESA, including the exclusivity provision. Following the effective date of the Regal Termination Agreement of July 14, 2023, Regal is no longer an ESA Party or related party and is included within the network affiliate metrics.

headings: {'The Noovie® Show Advertising': 'The Noovie® Show 廣告'}
{'(As of January 1, 2026)': '(截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日)'}
paragraphs: National CineMedia 是美國最大的電影院廣告平台。憑藉無與倫比的觸及率與規模，NCM 透過電影與流行文化的力量，將品牌與受歡迎的年輕、多元族羣觀眾連結。NCM 提供廣告客戶一個高階的視訊、全 funnel 營銷解決方案，提升廣告客戶測量與驅動成果的能力。NCM 的 Noovie® Show 唯一於 41 個領導性的全國與區域電影院路線中播放，包括所有三大全國連鎖影院 AMC、Cinemark 和 Regal。NCM 的電影院廣告平台包含超過 17,000 個銀幕，分佈於 184 個 Designated Market Areas®（"DMA®"）的 1,300 個電影院，包括前 50 名的所有地區。2025 年 11 月，NCM 透過收購 Spotlight 及 Spotlight Cinema Network，一家專門服務藝術影院、豪華影院與餐飲影院的美國電影院廣告公司，擴大其影響力。Spotlight 及 Spotlight Cinema Network 唯一於 108 個領導性的全國與區域電影院路線中播放 CineLife® Show，包含超過 1,200 個銀幕，分佈於 200 個電影院。

我們主要透過 The Noovie Show 與 CineLife Show 售賣廣告，為國家、區域與地方企業提供電影院廣告與娛樂節目，這些節目於美國各個電影院銀幕上播放。此外，我們也透過 Lobby Entertainment Network 或 LEN，一組 strategically-placed 銀幕，位於電影院大廳內，以及電影院大廳的其他促銷機會來產生收入。除了電影院之外，我們透過 NCMx 產品組合來擴展廣告觸及範圍，利用我們自有數位平台的跨通路再行銷，與第三方數位發行商與平台的合作，CTV 以及多種補充性的非電影院場域，例如便利商店與大學校園，來接觸電影院外的娛樂大眾。

本公司與 ESA Parties 簽訂長期 ESAs，並與我們的網路合作夥伴簽訂多年契約，這些契約賦予本公司在各自電影院中獨家銷售廣告的權利，僅有有限例外。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，與 ESA Parties 簽訂的 ESAs 剩餘平均年限約為 15.6 年。NCM 既有網路的合作夥伴契約於 2026 年 3 月 31 日至 2033 年 7 月 13 日間到期，其中最大的合作夥伴契約於 2033 年 7 月 13 日到期。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，NCM 網路的 ESAs 與合作夥伴契約的平均剩餘年限為 11.8 年。

NCM, Inc. 是一家德拉瓦州公司，於 2006 年 10 月 5 日成立，並於 2007 年 2 月 13 日開始營運，完成其首次公開發行後。NCM, Inc. 是一家控股公司，管理其合併子公司 NCM LLC。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，NCM, Inc. 除了現金及現金等價物與對 NCM LLC 100.0% 的普通單位權益外，沒有其他業務運作或重大資產。根據 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement，Cinemark 未來有潛在獲得 NCM LLC 普通單位的權利。根據 AMC Termination Agreement，AMC 將不再根據 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement 獲得 NCM LLC 的單位權益。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，AMC 與 Cinemark 對 NCM LLC 沒有權益。
本公司營運現金流的主要來源為根據 NCM LLC 營運協議，自 NCM LLC 收到的分紅。本公司亦根據與 NCM LLC 簽訂的管理服務協議，收取管理費。

Spotlight—於 2025 年 11 月 14 日，本公司取得 Spotlight，為美國唯一專門服務藝術影院、豪華影院及餐飲式影院業者的廣告公司。取得 Spotlight 使本公司平台增加高規模豪華銀幕與業者，提供獨特且吸引人的消費者體驗，並於全美各地戲院釋放新的廣告與預映娛樂存貨。Spotlight 的業者夥伴，包括 Cinépolis Luxury Cinema、Landmark Theatres、Flix Brewhouse 及 LOOK Dine-In Cinemas，補足本公司全國戲院網路，並擴展本公司在文化參與型高階客羣中的影響力。加入 Spotlight 的據點，使本公司全國市佔率提高超過 6.0%，並在紐約與洛杉磯等關鍵市場的戲院據點增加約 30.0%。本公司為取得 Spotlight 100.0% 的股權，支付 8.2 百萬美元的購併對價。Spotlight 自 2025 年 11 月 15 日至 2026 年 1 月 1 日已納入本公司財務報表。請參閱附註 5—企業合併，以取得更多關於取得與合併 Spotlight 的資訊。
AMC 廣告協議—於 2025 年 4 月 17 日，本公司與 AMC 簽訂第二修正重述業者服務協議（"2025 AMC 協議"）及一項獨立的終止協議（"AMC 終止協議"）。2025 AMC 協議將 ESA 的期限延長五年，更緊密地對應 NCM LLC 在 AMC 戲院分發的節目與 NCM LLC 廣告網路其餘部分的預映節目結構，並調整 NCM LLC 支付的對價。

LLC。AMC 終止協議放棄 AMC 在 IPO 時所簽訂某些協議之權利。這些協議依循 ASC 842—租賃的租賃修改指引進行會計處理，因修正後的 ESA 包含 AMC 銀幕的短期營運租賃。這些協議因同時由相同當事人簽訂，被視為一併處理。因此，根據這些協議，於 2025 年 6 月 26 日結息期，NCM LLC 釋放 21.6 百萬美元的 "TRA 應付金"，並轉銷 10.6 百萬美元來自 AMC 的應收款，與未支付的整合付款有關，以及 "預付費用及其他資產" 中的 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement 應收款。NCM 將不再有義務向 AMC 支付 TRA 付款、根據 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement 提供普通單位，或分派 NCM LLC 可用現金給 AMC。本公司已獲得修正後 ESA 的好處，包括預映節目結構的改進與在 AMC 戲院獨家廣告權。這些轉銷的淨影響已記入 "無形資產，減 amortization"，因 AMC 放棄此淨應付款被視為類似租賃激勵措施。無形資產因 ESA 的減少與 ESA 延長的合約期間，將導致 amortization 費用減少，因其被視為類似租賃費用。請參閱附註 6—無形資產、附註 7—所得稅、附註 13—承諾與或有事項，以及本公司於 2025 年 4 月 23 日向 SEC 提交的 Form 8-K，以取得更多關於這些協議的詳細資訊。

債務協議—於2025年1月24日，NCM LLC與美國銀行國家協會（U.S. Bank National Association）簽訂貸款與擔保協議，作為貸款人。此協議提供一個45.0百萬美元的高階擔保循環信貸融資（"2025信貸融資"），該信貸融資於2028年1月24日到期。為簽訂2025信貸融資，NCM LLC已償還截至2024年12月26日尚未償還的10.0百萬美元餘額，終止其先前貸款、擔保與保證協議（"2023循環信貸融資"）的所有承諾，並支付預付費用，金額為總承諾額的1.0%。2025信貸融資已降低本公司的總體利息支出，將到期日延長至2028年，並為以現金流為基礎的循環貸款，與2023循環信貸融資的以資產為基礎的循環貸款不同。截至2026年1月1日，NCM LLC在2025信貸融資下尚有12.0百萬美元未償還。2025信貸融資下的貸款可用於本公司營運資金及其他一般企業用途，貸款利率為浮動利率，等同於期貨SOFR（受零下限限制）加上適用的2.00%_margin，若發生違約事件，此_margin 可再增加2.00%。

反向股票分割—於2023年8月3日，本公司執行了一次十股換一股（1:10）的反向股票分割，每股票面價值為0.01美元。此反向股票分割將本公司普通股票的發行股數從2023年8月3日的174,112,385股減少至分割後的17,411,323股。在2023年8月7日取消Regal股票後，發行股數為13,343,065股。執行反向股票分割的主要目的是遵守本公司在"第11章程序"下討論的NCMI 9019和解協議義務，以及提高本公司普通股票的每股市場價格，以維持符合納斯達克持續上市標準。

Regal廣告協議—於2022年9月7日，Regal的母公司Cineworld Group plc及其部分子公司，包括Regal、Regal Cinemas, Inc.（曾為NCM LLC的ESA參與方）及Regal CineMedia Holdings, LLC（曾為與NCM LLC及本公司簽訂其他協議的參與方），在美國德州南部地方法院根據美國銀行法典第11章（Bankruptcy Code）第11條提出重組申請。在進行第11章程序的同時，Regal提出動議拒絕ESA，NCM LLC則提出對抗程序對Regal。於2023年6月3日，經過廣泛協商後，NCM LLC與Regal簽訂了網路合作夥伴交易協議（"Regal廣告協議"）。Regal廣告協議於2023年7月14日生效。根據另一份終止協議（"Regal終止協議"），於2023年7月14日生效，Regal拒絕並終止其ESA。此外，Regal及其附屬公司放棄所有與TRA、共同單位調整協議、軟體授權協議、董事指定協議、註冊權協議及所有其他在NCM LLC運作協議中提及的合資協議相關的權利與利益，並放棄對對方的主張。Regal也同意支持NCM LLC的計畫（如"第11章程序"下所定義），並放棄所有NCM, Inc.的股份。
在Regal廣告協議的同時，NCM LLC與Regal也同意無條件終止雙方之間關於NCM LLC請求執行ESA某些條款（包括獨佔條款）的持續訴訟。截至2023年7月14日，Regal已不再是NCM, Inc.或NCM LLC的ESA參與方，且自2023年7月14日起，Regal被納入網路合作夥伴的餘額與指標中。
於2023年4月11日，NCM LLC在美國德州南部地方法院根據美國銀行法典第11條（Bankruptcy Code）第11條提出自願重組申請（"第11章案件"），並根據預先安排的第11章計畫進行。

paragraphs: Spotlight—於 2025 年 11 月 14 日，NCM LLC 與 Spotlight Cinema Networks（"Spotlight"），一家專業電影廣告公司，簽訂了會員權益買賣協議（"MIPA"），本公司取得 Spotlight 100.0% 的股權。取得 Spotlight 後，本公司將增加高規模豪華銀幕與 exhibitors，這些 exhibitors 提供獨特且吸引人的消費者體驗至本公司平台，並啟用新的廣告與預映娛樂存貨。Spotlight 的 exhibitor 合作夥伴，包括 Cinépolis Luxury Cinema、Landmark Theatres、Flix Brewhouse 和 LOOK Dine-In Cinemas，補足 NCM 全國電影院網路，並擴展 NCM 在文化參與型高階觀眾中的影響力。加入 Spotlight 的據點，使 NCM 全國市場佔有率提高超過 6.0%，並在關鍵的紐約與洛杉磯市場，擴大其電影院據點約 30.0%。Spotlight 從 2025 年 11 月 15 日至 2026 年 1 月 1 日被納入本公司財務報表。有關取得與合併 Spotlight 的更多資訊，請參閱附註 5—企業合併。

AMC—於 2025 年 4 月 17 日，本公司與 AMC 簽訂了第二修正重述 exhibitor 服務協議（"2025 AMC 協議"）與一份獨立的終止協議（"AMC 終止協議"），由 NCM LLC、NCM, Inc. 與 AMC 簽訂。2025 AMC 協議將 ESA 的期限延長五年，更緊密地對應 NCM LLC 在 AMC 電影院分發的節目與 NCM LLC 其他廣告網路中主要的預映節目結構，並調整 NCM LLC 所支付的對價。AMC 終止協議放棄 AMC 在 IPO 時所簽訂某些協議之權利。這些協議依照 ASC 842—Leases 中的租賃修改指引進行會計處理，因修正後的 ESA 包含 AMC 電影院螢幕的短期營運租賃。這些協議被視為一併處理，因它們由相同當事人同時簽訂。由於這些協議，截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，NCM LLC 釋放了 24.8 百萬美元的 "TRA 應付帳款"，並反轉了 10.6 百萬美元的應收帳款，來自 AMC，與未支付的整合付款有關，以及 "預付費用及其他資產" 中的 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement 應收帳款。NCM 將不再有義務向 AMC 支付 TRA 付款、根據 Common Unit Adjustment Agreement 提供普通單位，或分派 NCM LLC 的可用現金給 AMC，本公司已獲得修正後 ESA 的好處，包括預映節目結構的改進與在 AMC 電影院獨家廣告權。這些
反轉的淨影響被記入 "減記後的無形資產"，因 AMC 放棄此淨應付款被視為類似租賃激勵措施。對 ESA 的無形資產減少與 ESA 優化期限的延長，將導致較低的攤銷費用，因它被視為類似租賃費用，於合約剩餘期限內。有關這些協議的更多細節，請參閱附註 6—無形資產、附註 7—所得稅、附註 13—承諾與或有事項，以及本公司於 2025 年 4 月 23 日向 SEC 提交的 Form 8-K。

債務協議—於 2025 年 1 月 24 日，NCM LLC 與 U.S. Bank National Association 簽訂貸款與擔保協議。協議提供 45.0 百萬美元的高級擔保循環信貸融資（"2025 信貸融資"），於 2028 年 1 月 24 日到期。在簽訂 2025 信貸融資時，NCM LLC 已償還截至 2024 年 12 月 26 日的 10.0 百萬美元餘額，並終止其 2023 循環信貸融資的所有承諾，並支付預付費用，為總承諾金額的 1%。2025 信貸融資預期將大幅降低本公司整體利息費用，將到期日延長至 2028 年，並為基於現金流的循環貸款，與 2023 循環信貸融資的資產基準循環貸款不同。截至 2026 年 1 月 1 日，NCM LLC 在 2025 信貸融資下有 12.0 百萬美元的餘額。2025 信貸融資下的貸款可用於本公司營運資金及其他一般企業用途，並以浮動利率計算，為 term SOFR（受零下限限制）加上適用的 2.00% 邊際利率，若發生違約事件，此邊際利率可能再增加 2.00%。

股票反向分割—於 2023 年 8 月 3 日，本公司實施了 1:10 的股票反向分割，每股票面價值為 0.01 美元。此反向分割將本公司普通股的發行股數從 2023 年 8 月 3 日的 174,112,385 股減少至分割後的 17,411,323 股。在 2023 年 8 月 7 日取消 Regal 股份後，發行股數為 13,343,065 股。實施此反向分割的主要目的是為了符合本公司根據 NCMI 9019 訴訟和解協議的義務，以及提高本公司普通股每股的市場價格，以維持符合納斯達克持續上市標準。

破產申請、去合併與重新合併 NCM LLC—於 2023 年 4 月 11 日，NCM LLC 向破產法院提交了根據美國法典第 11 編第 11 章預先安排的重組計畫的自願破產申請。在第 11 章案件期間，根據會計準則，本公司被認為不再控制 NCM LLC，因此自 2023 年 4 月 11 日起，NCM LLC 從本公司財務報表中去合併。本公司繼續根據美國法典第 11 編的授權，作為債務人管理人運作，直到第 11 章案件結束。

於 2023 年 6 月 27 日，破產法院頒布確認命令，正式批准揭露聲明並確認本公司的重整計畫。於 2023 年 8 月 7 日確認重整計畫後，所有使計畫生效的條件均已滿足或豁免，重整交易已 substantially consummated，NCM LLC 退出破產。其中，於生效日，根據重整計畫，NCM LLC 營運協議下的所有普通單位均已取消並終止，NCM, Inc. 收到 NCM LLC 普通單位，並將約 15.5 百萬美元的 NCM 資本投入轉移至 NCM LLC，NCM LLC 承擔某些未到期的執行契約及未到期租賃，包括 AMC 及 Cinemark 的 ESA，NCM LLC 將 8.8 百萬美元現金轉入專業費用保管帳戶，並將 15.0 百萬美元轉入無擔保債權人解決保管帳戶，用以處理一般無擔保債權池。NCM LLC 開始向債權人發放現金，包括向持有擔保債務主張的持有人發行 NCM, Inc. 普通股，且 NCM LLC 與 Exit Facility 簽訂協議以支持退出後的運作。根據重整計畫，NCM LLC 的所有歷史債務均已解除，NCM LLC 在 2023 年 12 月 28 日財年終結時，因破產而確認獲利 916.4 百萬美元。

此外，於從破產程序中脫離後，NCM, Inc. 恢復對 NCM LLC 的控制，並在考慮到 Secured Debt Claims 持有人選擇以 NCM, Inc. 普通股取代 NCM LLC 普通單位後，仍持有 100.0% 的 NCM LLC 股權，因此自 2023 年 8 月 7 日起，將 NCM LLC 重新納入本公司財務報表中，類似於 ASC 805 – 商業組合下的收購。根據 ASC 805 – 商業組合，NCM LLC 的資產與負債已調整至截至生效日的預估公允價值。
截至2026年1月1日，本公司尚未完成對一般無擔保債權池所有約定之付款，係因存在一項於破產法院進行中之預破產訴訟事件，該事件可能影響自一般無擔保債權池支付給其他無擔保債權人之金額。因此，本公司於2026年1月1日及2024年12月26日經審計之合併資產負債表中，於「受限制現金」及「應付帳款」項目內，持有總計3.0 百萬美元之資金及應計項目。

Regal 廣告協議—2022 年 9 月 7 日，Regal 的母公司 Cineworld Group plc 及其部分子公司，包括 Regal、Regal Cinemas, Inc.（曾為 NCM LLC 的 ESA 當事人）、Regal CineMedia Holdings, LLC（曾為 NCM LLC 及 NCM, Inc. 的其他協議當事人），於美國德州南部地方法院根據美國破產法第 11 章提出重組申請。2022 年 10 月 21 日，Regal 提出拒絕 ESA 的動議，但未指定拒絕生效日期，並表示 Regal 計畫與 NCM LLC 討論協議。NCM LLC 也提出反對訴訟，要求宣告救濟並取得禁制令，禁止 Regal 因與第三方簽訂新協議或將 NCM LLC 所執行的服務內化，而違反 ESA 中的獨佔、不競爭、不談判及保密條款。2023 年 2 月 1 日，Cineworld 提出對 NCM LLC 反對訴訟的總結判決動議。2023 年 5 月 5 日，NCM LLC 與 Regal 同意暫停進行中的訴訟，同時雙方努力達成新協議，讓 NCM LLC 繼續為 Regal 提供廣告服務。為避免進行 Regal 潛在拒絕 ESA 以及 NCM LLC 反對訴訟，雙方協商達成 Regal 廣告協議及 Regal 終止協議。Regal 廣告協議自 2023 年 7 月 14 日生效，規定 NCM LLC 取得 Regal 電影院內螢幕廣告的獨佔權，期限為十年，並根據 Regal 電影院的入場人數及 NCM LLC 透過 Regal 電影院螢幕廣告所產生的收入進行付款。

根據 Regal 廣告協議，NCM LLC 有權在 Regal 電影院內展示廣告，並提供以下廣告時長的庫存：(i) 最長五分鐘，在影片或數位節目開始前立即播放，(ii) 最長十分鐘，在影片開始後立即播放，延長 NCM LLC 可使用的時間五分鐘，以及 (iii) Platinum Spot，可能在最後兩支預告片前播放，長度為三十或六十秒，經 Regal 同意後，NCM LLC 可在 Platinum Spot 中展示兩個三十秒的廣告，以及一個 Gold Spot，為三十秒的廣告，立即在第四支預告片前播放。

根據 Regal 終止協議，自 2023 年 7 月 14 日生效，Regal 拒絕並終止了 ESA。此外，Regal 及其關聯公司放棄所有與 Tax Receivable Agreement、Common Unit Adjustment Agreement、Software License Agreement、Director Designation Agreement、Registration Rights Agreement 及 NCM LLC 公司運作協議中所描述的其他合資協議相關的權利與利益，並放棄對其他當事人的索賠。同時，根據 Regal 廣告協議，NCM LLC 與 Regal 同意撤銷與雙方之間進行中的訴訟，該訴訟涉及 NCM LLC 要求執行 ESA 中的某些條款，包括獨佔條款。自 2023 年 7 月 14 日 Regal 終止協議生效後，Regal 不再是 ESA 當事人或相關當事人，並納入網路加盟商指標中。

headings: 與本公司業務及產業相關之風險
戲院觀眾人數顯著下降可能會降低電影廣告的吸引力，並可能減少我們的營業收入。
戲院觀眾行為的變化可能會導致《The Noovie® Show》觀看人數下降，進而降低電影廣告的吸引力及我們的營業收入。
與ESAs相關的條款變更，或ESAs合作方缺乏支持，可能會對我們的營業收入、成長及獲利能力產生不利影響。
若ESAs或其它廣告協議中的非競爭條款被認為無法執行，則對方可能與我們競爭，進而對我們的業務產生不利影響。
與已宣告破產之ESAs合作方所訂立的ESA，可能被拒絕、重新協議或被認為無法執行。
疫情、傳染病或疾病爆發，例如冠狀病毒（COVID-19），已幹擾並可能對我們的業務及NCM LLC網路戲院的業務產生重大影響。
我們可能無法實現額外Post-Showtime存貨的預期效益，或無法成功增加NCM LLC擁有權限展示Post-Showtime存貨之戲院數量。
本公司業務嚴重依賴科技系統，任何系統故障、中斷或網路攻擊可能對本公司營運造成重大且不利的影響。
本公司開發額外數位或數位戶外收入機會的計畫可能無法執行，也可能無法達成。
2025 年信貸融資協議包含限制條款，未來可能無法為本公司提供足夠的資金資源與靈活性。
本公司透過資料與數位服務所收集並維護的個人資訊，以及來自第三方來源的個人資訊，可能使本公司面臨法律責任或導致本公司產生更高的營運費用。
廣告市場競爭激烈，本公司可能無法成功競爭。
若本公司未能持續升級科技，本公司業務可能無法成長，營業收入與營運毛利可能下降。
總體經濟不確定性或總體經濟條件惡化可能對本公司業務、營運結果或財務狀況造成不利影響。
本公司面臨因政府所頒布的法規變更、政府經費、貿易政策與關稅等措施而影響廣告客戶的風險。
本公司與劇場廣告的契約允許某些交易對手從事可能與本公司業務某些部分競爭的活動，這可能會降低本公司營業收入與成長潛力。
本公司依賴高階管理階層，若無法留住或更換這些高階管理階層，本公司業務可能會受到不利影響。
本公司在產品中使用人工智能技術，可能無法達到預期的效益。
本公司可能無法實現任何收購或投資預期的效益與協同效益。
本公司可能無法有效管理業務策略的變更，以持續擴大廣告存貨與網路的成長。
本公司營業收入與調整後營運資金經調整營業所得（Adjusted OIBDA）會按季浮動，且可能難以預測，這可能會增加本公司股票價格的波動性。
與本公司企業結構相關的風險
本公司為控股公司，本身沒有營運活動，並依賴來自NCM LLC的現金分配與支付，以履行本公司持續的義務。
paragraphs: 本公司普通股及其他證券之持有涉及某些風險。您應仔細考慮本文件中下列重大風險及其他資訊，包括我們的歷史財務報表及相關附註。本文件中所描述的重大風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。若本文件中所描述的任何風險與不確定性實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。這可能會導致本公司普通股交易價格下跌，甚至大幅下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
本公司業務受我們廣告網路中電影院出席人數的影響，而這些電影院經營於高度競爭的產業，其出席人數取決於吸引觀眾的電影是否存在。若電影院出席人數減少，或媒體買家認為我們的網路已不再符合其行銷計畫（因出席人數減少及地理覆蓋範圍縮小），將可能對我們的廣告業務價值造成不利影響。可能減少我們網路電影院出席人數的因素如下：
• 若 NCM LLC 的網路電影院線路因替代性電影發行方式的使用增加（包括主要電影的發行窗口縮短或完全取消，跳過電影院直接發行），而無法與其他娛樂方式競爭，包括網路及線上影片串流與下載；
• NCM LLC 的網路電影院線路預期會持續於部分電影院的劇場進行翻新，安裝較大、更舒適的座椅或調整座椅安排，減少劇場座位數與觀眾人數。這些翻新措施被觀眾視為正面，許多電影院線路也表示有意持續進行此類翻新；
• 電影院營運政策的變更，包括播放電影前的預告片數量與長度，可能導致 The Noovie® Show 的開始時間大幅延後，與實際電影開始時間差距更大；
• 任何導致消費者信心或可支配所得下降的因素，降低對電影的需求，或對電影製造或放映產業造成不利影響；
